players.product: 1.6T PAM4 DSP, TIAs, drivers, silicon photonics light engines, coherent DSP, custom XPU silicon

connects_to.relationship: custom XPU-attach silicon for the TPU ecosystem (AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, NICs, memory interface controllers, near-memory compute) under an expanded commercial agreement with warrant

contracts.signal: On July 29, 2026 Marvell and Google LLC entered into a commercial agreement relating to Marvell's development of custom semiconductor products for Google; the expanded partnership spans custom silicon programs that attach to the TPU ecosystem, including AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers and near-memory compute. In connection, Marvell issued Google a warrant whose non-time-based shares vest in 240 equal tranches, one tranche for each $500 million in Custom Products revenue from purchases by or on behalf of Google from Marvell's third quarter of fiscal 2027 through the end of fiscal 2033.
contracts.value: one warrant tranche vests per $500 million in Custom Products revenue (240 tranches)
